title: Medical Reviewer, Register Nurse Coder
description:
Medical Reviewer, RN Coder - Temporary Position
Location: Remote

*This role is a temporary position and that employment is expected to be for a limited duration (approx. 3-6 months)
About J29
J29, Inc . (J29) has been supporting commercial, State, and Federal health and human service programs since company inception in 2017 as an employee-centered healthcare management consulting company. Our team of 260 employees focuses on providing processing, review, and analysis of medical claims, records, data, and audits between areas of compliance, policy, and clinical expertise. Our team is experienced in program, payment, provider, and patient integrity as we continue to support advanced programs of policy, clinical requirements, and compliance measures at the commercial, State, and Federal levels.
J29 was founded to be an employee-centric company that prioritizes the well-being and value of its employees. Our mission is to empower our employees to do great things for the benefit of those that need it most. The J29 mission supports not only our health and human service programs, but also the philanthropy efforts of our team. We are proud to continue our support to non-profit groups with critical missions as J29 continues to grow.
Key Responsibilities
RVC Reviewers perform both automated and complex reviews of Medicare Fee-for-Service (FFS) claims-including Part A/B, DMEPOS, and Home Health/Hospice-to assess overpayments, underpayments, and proper payments as determined by Recovery Audit Contractors (RACs). They apply Medicare policies and guidelines, ensuring claims are evaluated according to National and Local Coverage Determinations and CMS rules, and document clear, accurate findings for each claim.
Reviewers participate in dispute resolution by re-examining claims and providing supporting documentation, support quality assurance through audits and ongoing training, and maintain compliance with CMS security and privacy standards. They also collaborate closely with key personnel to ensure consistency, accuracy, and continuous process improvement in all review activities.
Qualifications

• 5+ years of direct medical coding or medical billing experience, specifically in a healthcare environment.

• 3+ years working in a productivity-based claims or case working environment, out of a queued case management system.

• 3+ years working remotely with various technology systems. Ideally, candidate will have 3+ years of Medicare Fee For Service (FFS) experience in a medical coding role or program.

• Active Medical Coding Certification (CPC, CCS or equivalent) required

• Experience with low-code, no-code case management systems as an end-user is preferred but not required.

Education/Certification

• Active license as a Registered Nurse, in good standing, in the United States (as verified by Nurses). Verified regularly.

J29, Inc . is committed to hiring and retaining a diverse workforce. We are proud to be an Equal Opportunity/Affirmative Action Employer, making decisions without regard to race, color, religion, creed, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, marital status, national origin, age, veteran status, disability, or any other protected class.  J29, Inc . is a proud Veteran friendly employer.

title: Platform Security Engineer 2
description:
The Company
Dexcom Corporation (NASDAQ DXCM) is a pioneer and global leader in continuous glucose monitoring (CGM). Dexcom began as a small company with a big dream: To forever change how diabetes is managed. To unlock information and insights that drive better health outcomes. Here we are 25 years later, having pioneered an industry. And we're just getting started. We are broadening our vision beyond diabetes to empower people to take control of health. That means personalized, actionable insights aimed at solving important health challenges. To continue what we've started: Improving human health.
We are driven by thousands of ambitious, passionate people worldwide who are willing to fight like warriors to earn the trust of our customers by listening, serving with integrity, thinking big, and being dependable. We've already changed millions of lives and we're ready to change millions more. Our future ambition is to become a leading consumer health technology company while continuing to develop solutions for serious health conditions. We'll get there by constantly reinventing unique biosensing-technology experiences. Though we've come a long way from our small company days, our dreams are bigger than ever. The opportunity to improve health on a global scale stands before us.
Meet the team:
Product Security at Dexcom plays a critical role in safeguarding the integrity and security of our cutting-edge continuous glucose monitoring (CGM) devices. As an Application Security engineer, you would work with a number of cross functional teams to ensure software is developed securely in the context of results from scanning tools and manual review.
Where you come in:

• You will be integrating security tooling across all phases of the software development lifecycle, from CI/CD to production.

• You will drive the automation of security processes, ensuring efficient and seamless integration with application teams.

• You will collaborate with application teams to interpret, prioritize, and drive remediation of findings from security tools (SAST, DAST, IAST, SCA, SBOM, artifact scanning, container scanning, etc.)

• You will design and implement security guardrails within development processes to proactively detect and prevent vulnerabilities.

• You will experience with a variety of DevSecOps tools of the types mentioned above.

• You will develop and manage systems for the creation, delivery, and lifecycle management of Software Bill of Materials (SBOMs) across diverse platforms and products.

What makes you successful:

• You have deep understanding of the OWASP Top 10 vulnerabilities and mitigation strategies.

• You have proficiency in securing cloud-based and mobile applications, with a strong emphasis on cloud security architecture.

• You have experience with AI and securing AI models a plus

• You have experience writing and reviewing code in at least 1 of the following languages: Java, Scala, C# or similar.

• You have experience with DevOps practices and the secure software development lifecycle.

• You are proactive, inquisitive nature, constantly seeking out opportunities for improvement

• You are working knowledge of compliance frameworks and regulated environments (ISO 27001, NIST 800-171, NIST 800-53, etc.).

What you’ll get:

• A front row seat to life changing CGM technology. Learn about our brave #dexcomwarriors community.

• A full and comprehensive benefits program.

• Growth opportunities on a global scale.

• Access to career development through in-house learning programs and/or qualified tuition reimbursement.

• An exciting and innovative, industry-leading organization committed to our employees, customers, and the communities we serve.

Travel Required:

• 0-5%

Education and Experience:

• Typically requires a Bachelor’s degree in a technical discipline and 2-5 years of related experience, or a Master’s degree and 0-2 years of equivalent industry experience.

Remote Workplace: Your location will be a home office

title: Co-Founder & CEO - AI Native Recruiting Firm
description:
The Opportunity
FutureSight is seeking a Co-Founder & CEO to lead Foundry, an AI-Native Recruiting Agency currently in build at FutureSight . This is a co-founder partnership with meaningful founder equity, not a salaried executive role.
Recruiting has run on the same model for decades: firms charge a fixed percentage of a hire's first-year salary for work that is largely manual, sourcing, screening, and outreach done one candidate at a time. That pricing made sense when the work required a person doing it by hand. It doesn't anymore.
Market Context
Foundry is an AI-native recruiting firm built around a simple idea: use AI agents to handle sourcing, screening, and candidate evaluation, and keep a small human team focused on what still requires a person: building trust with clients and candidates, exercising judgment on close calls, and closing the placement. That shift in who does the work lets us offer clients a fee that's a fraction of what traditional firms charge, without cutting corners on quality.
This is where we believe recruiting is headed. AI-native service firms are starting to emerge and prove the model works, and we're building toward that shift deliberately.
About FutureSight

FutureSight is a leading venture builder that co-creates world-class software companies with values-driven entrepreneurs from inception to exit. We are a team of founders, operators and designers with experience successfully bringing software to market at scale.
You’ll co-create with a proven studio team, led by John Carbrey (4x entrepreneur, $100M ARR), Krista LaRiviere (3x exited, E&Y Top Women Entrepreneur), Alan Smith (Strategyzer co-founder, $120M in products built), Prathna Ramesh (former MD of Maple Leaf Angels, $275M in follow-on capital), and Johnny Tong (0-to-1 builder, acquired by SAP and Stripe) bring a rare combination of operator exits, institutional investing, and AI product depth.
The Partnership

• Founder equity with meaningful ownership from inception

• Pre-seed capital committed by FutureSight for early hires and MVP development, with potential for follow-on funding

• Venture building resources, including embedded design, engineering, growth, and fundraising support from day one

• Investor and advisor network across vertical AI and early-stage capital markets

• A true co-creation model in which you operate as CEO with FutureSight 's cross-functional team as your partner

What you'll own
As Co-Founder & CEO, you will set the venture's direction and lead its execution.

• Strategy - Refine the ICP, pricing model, and product positioning

• Customer Development - Lead pilot placements with design-partner companies, convert them to paid retained relationships, and build the go-to-market motion

• Product - Partner with the FutureSight product and engineering team to ship V1 and iterate on user feedback

• Capital - Lead the seed raise, supported by FutureSight 's network and traction

• Team - Recruit and lead the founding team, and establish the cultural foundation of the company

Co-Founder Profile

• Previous founding experience at a venture-backed company

• Demonstrated success in B2B AI or B2B SaaS go-to-market, including consultative, relationship-driven sales and customer engagement

• Fundraising fluency, with the ability to develop investor narratives and close capital

• Proven ability to attract, develop, and retain top talent

• Clear-eyed understanding of the risks and demands of co-founding a venture-backed company

• Deep domain expertise in recruiting, staffing, or talent acquisition, as a builder operator or agency leader

How to Apply
Please submit your resume, LinkedIn profile, and a brief note on why this venture aligns with your goals as a founder. We will move quickly for the right candidate.
FutureSight is committed to diversity, equity, and inclusion. We welcome applicants of all backgrounds and experiences.

title: Senior Product Sourcing Engineer, General
description:
Anduril Industries is a defense technology company with a mission to transform U.S. and allied military capabilities with advanced technology. By bringing the expertise, technology, and business model of the 21st century’s most innovative companies to the defense industry, Anduril is changing how military systems are designed, built and sold. Anduril’s family of systems is powered by Lattice OS, an AI-powered operating system that turns thousands of data streams into a realtime, 3D command and control center. As the world enters an era of strategic competition, Anduril is committed to bringing cutting-edge autonomy, AI, computer vision, sensor fusion, and networking technology to the military in months, not years.

ABOUT THE JOB

At Anduril, our Product Sourcing Engineers are the critical link between engineering design and supply chain execution - making sure our hardware is manufacturable, cost-effective, and ready to scale from day one. You'll operate in a fast-paced environment alongside design, manufacturing, and quality teams, influencing product architecture early and building supplier pipelines that hold up under real production pressure. We're looking for technical sourcing professionals with deep expertise in design-for-manufacturability, cost engineering, and supplier qualification to help build the next generation of defense technology.

WHAT YOU’LL DO

• Shape the Design Early: Embed with Design Engineering during concept and prototype phases to run technical reviews, drive DFM/DFA, and align design intent with what suppliers can actually build at rate.

• Qualify the Supply Base: Evaluate and select global suppliers based on technical capability, process maturity, quality systems, and capacity to deliver complex assemblies against aggressive schedules.

• Own the Cost Curve: Lead should-cost analyses, teardowns, and process assessments to expose cost drivers and drive design-to-cost initiatives without compromising performance, reliability, or margin.

• Land NPI into Production: Run the technical transition from NPI into serial production - first-article inspections, PPAP, yield ramp, and resolution of early-stage manufacturing issues at the supplier floor.

• De-Risk the Build: Identify technical single points of failure, qualify alternate processes or sources, and drive ECOs and corrective actions to unblock supplier-facing build issues before they hit the program.

REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS

• Experience: Bachelor's degree in Mechanical, Electrical, Manufacturing, or a related engineering discipline, with 3+ years in a hybrid engineering / sourcing / supply chain role delivering hardware into production.

• Manufacturing Process Depth: Strong working knowledge of the manufacturing processes relevant to your commodity and their cost drivers - able to walk a supplier floor and identify what's real, what's optimistic, and what will fail at scale.

• Drawings & GD&T: Fluent in engineering drawings, schematics, and CAD models, with solid GD&T instincts to reconcile design tolerances with supplier process capability.

• Supplier Engagement & Root-Cause: Track record of working shoulder-to-shoulder with suppliers to troubleshoot fab issues, improve yield, and drive rigorous root-cause corrective action (8D / CAPA).

• Clearance: Eligible to obtain and maintain an active U.S. Top Secret security clearance.

Them: Bureaucrats, city councils, mayors, governors, and federal agencies stripping Americans of their rights every day. There’s a lot of government overreach out there, and it’s backed by seemingly endless resources.
Us: We fight back. Pacific Legal Foundation is the nation’s first and most successful public interest law firm dedicated to vindicating individual liberty. PLF has an unmatched record in the U.S. Supreme Court, with 18 victories out of 21 cases heard by the Court. PLF also has nearly 200 active cases across the nation. title: Head of Marketing, Langfuse

We are now part of ClickHouse. The core of the role is still product marketing and developer trust: positioning, launches, category narrative, developer content, website, customer proof, lifecycle, funnel, sales enablement, and the way we explain Langfuse to technical users and technical buyers. If you’re driven by impact, pace, and raising the bar. This is the place.

ABOUT THE ROLE

Let's get the tricky part out of the way. Legal Engineering does not fit neatly into a traditional box. It combines legal practice, product fluency, client leadership and practical change management. The job exists because software alone does not change how legal work gets done. Someone has to understand the work well enough to redesign it, and be credible enough that lawyers listen.

As a Legal Engineer in Dubai, you sit between the lawyers using Legora and the people building it. You will work with law firms and in-house legal teams across the Middle East: running pilots, leading onboarding and rollouts, designing the workflows that make the platform genuinely useful for a specific team, and teaching people to use it well. When something does not work, you find out why and either fix it with the client or get it in front of Product with enough evidence to act on.

This is a client-facing craft role, not an account-management role. The measure of your work is whether real lawyers do real work differently because of what you built and taught.

The Middle East is its own market. The enterprise opportunity spans international firms, leading regional firms and in-house teams at large corporates and sovereign-linked entities. The legal landscape covers federal law, emirate-level systems and the common-law free zones of DIFC and ADGM. Arabic-language work and a credible answer on data protection and hosting are part of the job here, not an edge case.

Dubai is an early team. You will help decide how Legal Engineering works in this region rather than inherit a finished playbook.

We hire from both, and we mean it. Neither route is the preferred one.

From a law firm. You have done substantive legal work at a firm where quality was not negotiable, and you understand how matters are actually run: the pressure, the economics, the billing model, and why partners adopt some things and quietly ignore others. Perhaps you led a knowledge or innovation initiative, or you were the person in your team who worked out what the new tools could really do. You know how to earn the trust of sceptical, technical lawyers, because you have been one.

From an in-house team. You have worked inside a legal function, balancing competing business priorities and doing more with less. Who is a Billing Manager?

A Billing Managerin a medical company is responsible for monitoring and ensuring all financial operations related to a patient’s stay in the hospital, including:

• Working with Census (checking the information in the system before sending the claims to the insurance)

• Checking the claims over the phone and online

• Working on the case of the patient until the full payment is received (sending the claims for reprocessing in case it’s denied incorrectly, sending corrected claims or appeals)

• Preparing letters/bills to patients and discussing the balances with the patients over the phone

title: Data Scientist Freelance (Freelance)
description:
📋 Taken en verantwoordelijkheden
Voor een data-gedreven proof of concept zoeken we 2 profielen die meewerken aan de ontwikkeling van een overdraagbare oplossing voor de geautomatiseerde detectie en verklaring van trendwijzigingen in binnenvaarttrafieken.
De beschikbare data bevatten onder meer informatie over vervoersstromen, herkomst en bestemming, corridors, ladingen en lossingen, tonnages, doorvaarten en andere reiskenmerken. De opdracht onderzoekt in welke mate technologie relevante evoluties automatisch kan signaleren, mogelijke verklarende parameters kan identificeren en de sterkte en onzekerheid van verbanden transparant kan weergeven.
Het gaat nadrukkelijk om een ondersteunend analyse-instrument en niet om een autonoom beslissingssysteem. Inhoudelijke validatie door de eindorganisatie blijft noodzakelijk. De opdracht moet bovendien aantonen of deze aanpak technisch, organisatorisch en operationeel haalbaar is binnen de bestaande ICT-context.

• Een proof of concept ontwerpen, bouwen, testen, documenteren en overdraagbaar opleveren.

• Trendwijzigingen, afwijkingen en trendbreuken in trafiekdata automatisch detecteren en analyseren.

• Directe en indirecte verbanden onderzoeken tussen trafiekdata en interne of externe verklarende variabelen.

• Rapporteren op een transparante manier over bron, methode, sterkte van verbanden, onzekerheid, beperkingen en reproduceerbaarheid.

• Een werkend en testbaar prototype opleveren binnen de goedgekeurde projectomgeving.

• Rekening houden met functionaliteit, beveiliging, technische haalbaarheid, toegangsbeheer, dataclassificatie en integratiemogelijkheden.

• Zorgen voor volledige kennisoverdracht, inclusief broncode, configuratie en technische documentatie, zodat verdere uitbreiding en beheer mogelijk blijven.

• Complexe analyses helder toelichten aan stakeholders met uiteenlopende technische achtergronden.

📝 Jouw profiel

• Je hebt ruime ervaring met data-analyse en het analyseren van datastromen.

• Je hebt sterke kennis van tijdreeksanalyse, trenddetectie en change point detectie, bijvoorbeeld met tools zoals Darts, Sktime of PyTorch Forecasting.

• Je beheerst scriptingtalen zoals Python en/of R; kennis van Shell of Perl is een meerwaarde.

• Je hebt grondige kennis van SQL, databanken zoals Oracle en het optimaliseren of tunen van databases en queries.

• Je hebt ervaring met data modelling, bij voorkeur in een Databricks-omgeving.

• Je beschikt over kennis van LLM en RAG.

• Je hebt ervaring met Power BI voor dashboards, datavisualisatie en data-optimalisatie, en je kan noden van stakeholders vertalen naar passende Power BI-oplossingen.

• Je hebt kennis van gevorderde statistische technieken en concepten.

• Je bent sterk in rapportering en kan bevindingen gestructureerd en begrijpelijk presenteren.

• Ervaring met projecten binnen de overheid is een plus.

⚠️ Deze functie wordt aangeboden als een deeltijdse freelance rol (40%).

title: Steuerassistent:in (w/m/d)
description:
SKALAR - Wir bauen die digitale Steuerkanzlei der Zukunft

Radikal einfach. Voll digital. 100% mandantenfokussiert.

Wir denken Steuerberatung komplett neu: einfacher, schneller und transparenter für Mandanten und Kanzleiteam zugleich.

Wo andere Kanzleien mit manuellen Prozessen, langen Wartezeiten und intransparenter Kommunikation kämpfen, bauen wir ein völlig neues Erlebnis - digital, proaktiv, KI-gestützt. Mit automatisierten Prozessen im Hintergrund und digitalen Schnittstellen zum Mandanten laufen repetitive Aufgaben weitgehend von selbst - damit du Zeit hast für das, was wirklich zählt: anspruchsvolle Beratung, Sonderfälle und strategische Mandantenfragen.

Der Unterschied zu anderen "Digitalkanzleien": Über die Hälfte unseres Teams sind Softwareentwickler. Du gestaltest direkt mit, was sie bauen - und damit, wie KI-gestützte Steuerberatung in dieser Branche überhaupt aussehen wird. Dein Steuerwissen prägt das Produkt, nicht nur dessen Anwendung.

Wir sind ein erfahrenes Gründerteam aus Steuerberatern, Digital-Unternehmern und Softwareentwicklern mit einem Exit-Track-Record von 140 Mio. €. Mit dir gemeinsam möchten wir eine der führenden Kanzleien Deutschlands aufbauen.

AUFGABEN

- Jahresabschlüsse eigenständig erstellen - Handels- und Steuerbilanzen sowie E-Bilanzen für dein Mandantenportfolio, auf DATEV-Basis und mit KI-Tools, die dir die Vorarbeit abnehmen

- Betriebliche und private Steuererklärungen erstellen - ESt, KSt, GewSt, USt und gesonderte Feststellungen, inklusive komplexerer Sachverhalte; die finale Abstimmung übernimmst du gemeinsam mit einem Berufsträger

- Steuerbescheide prüfen und Einsprüche vorbereiten - du führst den Schriftverkehr mit der Finanzverwaltung und behältst Fristen im Blick

- Fachliche Ansprechpartner:in für deine Mandanten - von der Klärung steuerlicher Fragen bis zur Besprechung des Abschlusses

- Qualität der laufenden Buchhaltung sichern - du prüfst die Fibu abschlussorientiert und bist Sparringspartner:in für unsere Steuerfachangestellten

- Prozesse mit unseren Softwareentwicklern weiterentwickeln - du beschreibst das Problem im Abschluss- und Deklarationsprozess, gemeinsam baut ihr die Lösung

QUALIFIKATION

- Abgeschlossene Ausbildung als Steuerfachangestellte:r mit mindestens 3 Jahren Berufserfahrung, davon ein wesentlicher Teil in der eigenständigen Erstellung von Jahresabschlüssen und Steuererklärungen

- Sicheres Fachwissen in Bilanzierung nach HGB und in den Ertragsteuern sowie routinierter Umgang mit DATEV (Rechnungswesen, Jahresabschluss, Steuerprogramme)

- Strukturierte, eigenverantwortliche Arbeitsweise mit hohem Qualitätsanspruch und sichere Kommunikation mit Mandanten und Finanzverwaltung

- Du erkennst, wo Prozesse haken, willst sie nicht hinnehmen, sondern abschaffen, und bist offen, innovative Lösungen zu testen und weiterzuentwickeln

- Unternehmerisches Denken und Interesse, eine der führenden Kanzleien Deutschlands mit aufzubauen

- Nice to have: begonnene oder abgeschlossene Weiterbildung zum/zur Steuerfachwirt:in oder Bilanzbuchhalter:in

BENEFITS

- 🧠 Du baust mit, was Steuerberatung morgen ist - KI-gestützte Beratungsformate, die es so noch nicht gibt. Du entscheidest mit, wie Top-Beratung in der Zukunft aussieht

- 🤝 Steile Lernkurve mit Gründern und Tech-Team - Direkte Zusammenarbeit im Alltag, gegenseitiges Sparring auf Augenhöhe

- 🚀 Volle Verantwortung ab Tag 1 - Eigene Mandate, Leistungsportfolio, Wachstumsstrategie - du gestaltest mit

- 🛠️ Modernes Tech-Setup - Digitale Prozesse, KI-gestützte Tools, klare Strukturen

- 💰 Kompetitives Gehaltspaket + option auf Anteile (VSOP)

- 🏠 Hybrides Arbeiten - Homeoffice und Büro flexibel kombinieren

- 📍 Büro im Herzen Münchens, top angebunden

Bereit, Steuerberatung neu zu definieren?

Werde Teil von Skalar - und gestalte mit uns das modernste Mandantenerlebnis Deutschlands.

Build and Direct High-Performing Teams : Recruit, mentor, and lead a functional organization of Subsystem PMs, establishing clear team goals, operational work plans, and performance benchmarks to drive portfolio execution.

Hardware & Networking Architecture Expertise : Deep technical command of enterprise storage hardware, server compute platforms, backend interconnects, and high-speed networking protocols (Ethernet, Fibre Channel, NVMe-oF).

Job Title: Process & Automation Specialist
Location: Remote

Who Are We?
At Reef, we connect elite talent with high-growth companies building world-class teams.
We work exclusively with the top 3% of candidates and match them with established companies across Australia, New Zealand, the US, and UK that are serious about investing in their people and operational infrastructure.
We support your integration into these companies by providing additional training, admin/HR support, and access to our growing community of high-performing professionals.
About the Company
Our client is a growing Australian business focused on improving operational efficiency through systems, process optimisation, and automation.
As the business scales, they are investing in reducing manual workflows, improving cross-functional efficiency, and implementing automation across sales, fulfilment, and internal operations to support long-term growth.
With fragmented systems and repetitive processes creating operational bottlenecks, the company is now seeking a specialist who can identify inefficiencies, build scalable automation solutions, and improve how the business runs.

Excellent spoken and written English

description:
Acerca del Grupo QuintoAndar

Somos el Grupo QuintoAndar, el ecosistema inmobiliario más grande de América Latina . Guiados por el propósito de ayudar a las personas a amar el lugar donde viven , creamos tecnología y soluciones que simplifican toda la experiencia de la vivienda, desde el alquiler hasta la compra y venta.

Estamos presentes en 6 países (Brasil, México, Argentina, Perú, Ecuador y Panamá) y contamos con un hub de tecnología en Portugal , reuniendo a más de 3.100 personas unidas por el desafío de transformar el sector. Con el respaldo de inversionistas globales como SoftBank, General Atlantic y Kaszek, hemos levantado más de US$ 755 millones y hoy somos una compañía valuada en US$ 5,1 mil millones .

Lideramos la transformación del mercado siendo pioneros en la aplicación de Inteligencia Artificial a gran escala en el sector inmobiliario. Nuestras plataformas suman más de 50 millones de visitas al mes, administrando más de 350 mil contratos de alquiler activos y movilizando R$ 20 mil millones al año.

Si buscas resolver problemas complejos con autonomía, tecnología de punta e impacto a gran escala, adelante, estás en tu casa.

Para conocer más sobre nuestra historia, ingresa a: grupoquintoandar.com/es/

Ubicación y Modelo de Trabajo

Nuestro equipo comercial trabaja bajo el modelo híbrido, combinando la flexibilidad del trabajo remoto con el intercambio presencial en nuestra oficina de Ciudad de México, 3 veces por semana.

Sobre el Equipo y el Desafío

El equipo de Retención es responsable de reducir la tasa de deserción y maximizar el valor de vida del cliente enfocado exclusivamente en el portafolio de pequeñas y medianas empresas . Esta es una posición de alto impacto y de nueva creación en México; serás responsable de frenar la principal fuga de revenue de la operación, construyendo los cimientos de la retención a nivel local. Buscamos personas con fuertes habilidades de negociación, empatía y resiliencia para liderar a un equipo de 5 personas.

Tus Responsabilidades

• Dirigir, motivar y capacitar a un equipo de retención de 5 personas con perfil junior (mayormente nivel banda 2), brindando un acompañamiento cercano (micromanagement y coaching) para desarrollar sus habilidades de negociación desde cero .

•
Ejecutar estrategias de retención alineando los descuentos previos a la nueva lista de precios, utilizando palancas estratégicas para contener las bajas minimizando el impacto en el ARPA .

•
Gestionar operativamente el flujo de casos de clientes que solicitan darse de baja, los cuales son escalados a través de Salesforce Chatter por los equipos de SMB, Cobranzas y Atención al Cliente .

title: Supervisor de Vendas (PI)
description:
O Supervisor de Vendas é responsável por coordenar e monitorar o desempenho comercial de uma ou mais linhas de produtos específicas da Anton Paar, garantindo o alcance das metas de vendas, a saúde do *pipeline*, o acompanhamento estratégico de oportunidades e o suporte direto à equipe de vendas.
Atua como elo entre a equipe de vendas, clientes, áreas internas e a matriz, contribuindo para decisões estratégicas, negociações relevantes, monitoramento de KPIs, previsão de vendas e o desenvolvimento de ações necessárias para o crescimento sustentável da linha de produtos sob sua responsabilidade.
Principais Responsabilidades e Atividades
Gestão da linha de produtos sob sua responsabilidade

• Monitorar o desempenho comercial mensal da linha, acompanhando resultados de vendas, projeções de receita, oportunidades em aberto e o progresso em relação à meta anual.

• Analisar a saúde do *pipeline* da linha sob sua responsabilidade, avaliando o volume de oportunidades, o estágio no funil de vendas, a probabilidade de sucesso, os prazos previstos de fechamento e os riscos relacionados ao alcance das metas.

• Realizar acompanhamentos individuais mensais com os vendedores responsáveis ​​pelas oportunidades da linha, revisando KPIs, status de negociação, qualidade do funil, prioridades comerciais e próximos passos.

• Apoiar a definição de estratégias comerciais para garantir o alcance das metas da linha, considerando o mercado, clientes estratégicos, carteira ativa, oportunidades em andamento e ações necessárias para o desenvolvimento de novos negócios.

Monitoramento de vendas, previsão (*forecast*) e KPIs

• Monitorar os números mensais de vendas da linha, bem como a projeção de vendas até o final do ano, antecipando possíveis desvios e propondo ações corretivas.

• Monitorar indicadores de vendas, como oportunidades em aberto, progresso no funil de vendas, probabilidade de fechamento, volume de propostas, descontos aplicados, previsão de vendas (*forecast*), conversão de oportunidades e aderência às metas.

• Garantir que as informações relacionadas às oportunidades estejam atualizadas no CRM, permitindo análises confiáveis ​​do *pipeline*, da previsão de vendas e do desempenho da linha.

• Avaliar oportunidades estratégicas com a equipe de vendas, apoiando a priorização de clientes, negociações e ações comerciais de maior impacto.

Suporte à equipe de vendas

• Fornecer suporte direto à equipe de vendas em negociações relevantes, visitas estratégicas, definição da abordagem comercial e acompanhamento de oportunidades críticas.

• Participar de visitas a clientes com os vendedores quando necessário, especialmente em oportunidades estratégicas, negociações complexas ou contas de maior relevância para a linha. Apoiar a equipe de vendas na análise e concessão de descontos, considerando a estratégia de vendas, a relevância da oportunidade, a competitividade, o relacionamento com o cliente e o impacto nos resultados da linha de produtos.

• Orientar a equipe de vendas quanto às prioridades da linha, auxiliando na tomada de decisão sobre quais oportunidades devem receber maior foco e acompanhamento.

• Dar suporte a processos comerciais específicos, incluindo licitações, solicitações de importação e alinhamentos técnicos e comerciais, sempre que relacionados às linhas de produtos sob sua responsabilidade.

Relacionamento com clientes, áreas internas e matriz

• Manter bom relacionamento com clientes estratégicos, atuando como suporte à equipe de vendas em negociações, visitas e discussões comerciais ou técnicas, quando necessário.

• Atuar em conjunto com áreas internas envolvidas no processo comercial, como logística, importação, financeiro, serviços, aplicações, marketing e outras áreas de suporte.

• Comunicar-se com a equipe da matriz quando necessário, incluindo solicitações de suporte técnico, alinhamento de estratégias globais, acompanhamento de importações, priorização de demandas ou apresentação dos resultados da linha de produtos n

About the team

OpenAI is building a new generation of AI-powered consumer devices, creating opportunities to bring increasingly capable AI into people's everyday lives.

Our Data Engineering team is responsible for establishing the foundational data infrastructure that supports the development, manufacturing, launch, and ongoing operation of these products. We're building the systems that connect information across the entire device lifecycle, enabling engineering, operations, and Data Science partners to understand product performance, identify problems, and make better decisions.

This is an early-stage organization with significant greenfield opportunities. We're looking for engineers who want to shape the technical foundations of a rapidly growing business and establish systems that will scale alongside our products.

About the role:

As a Data Engineer, you'll design, build, and scale the data infrastructure that powers OpenAI's hardware and consumer devices organization.

You'll tackle technically challenging problems involving complex data sources, evolving operational requirements, and systems that need to scale from early development through manufacturing and consumer deployment.

Unlike roles focused primarily on supporting individual analytics projects, this position emphasizes building durable, reusable data foundations that enable multiple teams and use cases.

You'll have significant ownership over technical decisions, work closely with partners across engineering, manufacturing, operations, and Data Science, and help define how we approach Data Engineering as the organization grows.

- Shape our technical direction: Help establish engineering standards, architectural principles, data quality practices, and infrastructure decisions that will influence the organization for years to come.

• Manage database security - roles, permissions, access control, and auditing.

• Proactively monitor database health and performance, identifying and resolving issues before they affect production.

• Plan and execute database migrations to the cloud, optimizing configurations for target environments, and ensuring performance, security, resiliency, and recoverability throughout the transition.

• Build strong working relationships with engineering teams, communicating database constraints and recommendations in terms they can act on.

• Share database expertise and best practices with less experienced administrators and engineering team members.

· Performs other duties as assigned.

QUALIFICATIONS

· Required Qualifications:

o BA/BS in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field, with 5+ years of experience in data operations or database administration, or MS with 3+ years of experience.

o Demonstrated experience as a database administrator with SQL Server and/or PostgreSQL, including performance tuning, backup and recovery, high availability, security and access management, and capacity planning.
